title: Turn finite closed-state progress into one universal word and a physical-time tail
statement: For finite total deterministic maps with a forward-invariant target and every typed state reaching it, at most n non-target states give one universal word of length <=n^2 by successively tracking and absorbing images. If all influences are included in independent positive-rate clocks and the request remains fixed/closed, its exact-word event has positive probability p=exp(-Lambda*delta*M)*product(lambda_word*delta), >=(lambda_min/(eLambda))^M at delta=1/Lambda. From adaptive starts the failure tail is <=(1-p)^number_of_blocks. This proves progress under the closed fixed-request premises, not payload correctness, cleanup, throughput or a deadline from weak fairness alone.
